prompt:
Deliverable: one painterly dark gothic anime light-novel event illustration, landscape 16:9, a single finished opaque scene with exactly two seated adult characters and nobody else; the reference images are numbered below the prompt.
SUBJECT: two characters, each drawn at full identity fidelity. FADYME is an adult woman aged 22, drawn exactly as the woman in reference image 1, with the same face, hair, eyes and costume: pale ash-blonde hair, a cool light beige-blonde with ash-grey shading, in long soft waves falling to the chest; violet eyes, a pale lavender-grey violet; a deep plum hood raised over her head, plum fabric (#45293B in the light, #22151E in shadow) with silver-lilac (#C9B6E4) vine embroidery along the hood edge and the mantle borders; on the front edge of the hood above the brow one small broken fragment of a silver circlet; one tiny silver bell-shaped hairpin at the side of her face, partly hidden by the hood edge and her hair; under the mantle a black high-collar dress with silver-lilac embroidery and a high, clean, white scarf (bone ivory, #E9E2D4) folded up under her chin; thin, matte, dark gloves; her small silver bell, with a long slender silver thorn as its clapper hanging still, rests in her lap on its fine silver chain. MAHMUT is an adult man aged 28, a tall weathered former sworn palace guard, drawn exactly as the man in reference image 2, with the same face, hair and armour: dark messy hair, stubble along the jaw and chin, brown eyes, tired but steady; dark worn half-plate repaired in several mismatched styles by village smiths, with a dark steel gorget, a breastplate and layered pauldrons with patched plates and mismatched rivets; a small Crown Guard star mounted on the centre of the breastplate and, directly above it, a small empty hammered-out socket, bare roughened plate, where a crown once sat; scarred, scuffed gloves; a tattered oxblood cloak, Guard red dyed darker into a deep brownish crimson (lit mid-tone #6B1E2C, shadow #371C21), hanging from his shoulders behind him over the stone with bold ragged torn edges; no helmet, no raised hood; his sword stays sheathed at his hip. Mahmut is clearly taller and broader than Fadyme, who is the smaller and slighter of the two.
SETTING: the Whispering Ash Forest at dusk, beside a narrow muddy path. Location canon, quoted: "Damp overgrown forest: layered mossy and dark pine greens under a pale ash-grey canopy of ash trees whose pale leaves look like drifting ash; rain and low mist; a narrow muddy road; old trunks with names carved into the bark". Story canon, quoted: "Beyond the narrow path, a fallen stone offered a seat." They sit side by side on one long fallen block of old dressed stone, weathered and half sunk in moss and fern, a toppled piece of a ruined wall. Behind them stand the broken, moss-covered remains of that old wall and one slanted ash trunk whose bark carries scratched marks that form no readable letters; beyond, pale ash trees dissolve into low mist as in reference image 3, and the narrow path bends away at the far left. Greens stay grey-green and desaturated.
ACTION: canon, quoted: "She drew his wrist toward her and threaded the loose leather through its buckle." They are turned toward each other in three-quarter view, Fadyme on the left of the picture facing right, Mahmut on the right facing left. In the middle of the picture, at about 55% of the height, his forearm rests across his knee and the wrist nearest her, held in her two gloved hands, is drawn toward her; a loose strap of plain brown leather at that wrist, with a small dull iron buckle, is being threaded through the buckle by the fingers of one of her hands while her other hand steadies his wrist; every visible hand has five clear fingers. Her eyes are lowered to the strap and her closed lips hold a small, private half-smile, a dry amusement softened toward warmth. His eyes are lowered to her fingers instead of the trees; his mouth is closed and relaxed, with only a faint easing around the eyes, tired but steady, a quiet watchful warmth. They sit a hand's width apart, and nothing touches except her hands on his wrist. Calm, hushed, restrained, understated.
COMPOSITION: eye-level camera at seated height, a medium shot of the two seated figures from the head down to the knees, centred in the picture, both figures at least 8% inside the left and right edges. Measured as fractions of the picture height from the top: the top 14% is deep, low-detail shadowed canopy with no bright spot; the top of Mahmut's hair is at about 16% and the top of Fadyme's hood at about 25%, so she sits visibly smaller, about half a head lower, her shoulders about two thirds as wide as his; his eyes are at about 27% and hers at about 36%; both faces, all hands and the strap sit between 14% and 72% of the height; the lowest 28% is quiet: the fallen stone, the folds of her mantle and his cloak and the ground, with no bright spot and no detail that draws the eye. The pair occupies the middle 55% of the width; the left and right edges hold forest and the broken wall.
STYLE: painterly dark gothic anime light-novel illustration, detailed faces and eyes, thin soft plum-black linework on the figures (never pure black), slightly heavier on the outer silhouettes; soft cel shading on the skin in two or three value steps; painterly gradients and fold occlusion on matte woven cloth, worn dull metal and scuffed leather; the environment painted with soft edges and no outlines, painted masonry, visible brush grain and paper tooth, no gloss. Quiet, hushed, melancholic, understated.
LIGHT AND PALETTE: dusk, the last cool light between the trees: cool slate ambient light (#3B434D and #474A54) on faces, hands and cloth. One low warm amber light (#D9A441) glows between distant trunks at the far left of the picture at about 50% of the height, behind the characters, and gives a thin warm rim to the left edge of Fadyme's hood and shoulder, to the left of Mahmut's hair and pauldron, and a small warm glint on the leather strap; no other warm light, no sun disc, no rays. A faint cool silver-lilac (#C9B6E4) edge light traces the outline of her plum hood so it separates from the dark forest. Charcoal-violet shadows (#22151E, never darker than #0F0D11), forest shadow #1F2626, foliage #333C3B, mist (#C2CCCF) only in the far distance, plum, silver-lilac and bone ivory on her costume, oxblood only on his cloak; low saturation except the plum, the lilac and the single amber; most of the picture is dark, nothing pure black or pure white, the brightest highlight no brighter than #F2EDE4. A few pale ash flakes drift in the air.
TECHNICAL: an opaque full-bleed painting filling the whole canvas edge to edge, no letterbox bars, frame or border; the background is painted forest scenery, not a flat colour; text-free.
Do not include: text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks; extra, missing or fused fingers; a third person, animals; a white streak in her hair, blood on her scarf, glowing lines on her skin; red, burgundy or gold clothing on Fadyme, a bright red or purple cloak, a helmet, a crown or royal crest on his armour; modern items, glasses; chroma-key green, borders, UI.
